products.short_description: Elegant, effortless, and made to be styled your way, the Aurelia Linen Convertible Dress is a timeless piece designed for comfort and versatility.
products.description_html:
Elegant, effortless, and made to be styled your way, the Aurelia Linen Convertible Dress is a timeless piece designed for comfort and versatility. Crafted from a lightweight linen-blend fabric, this dress features a flowy layered silhouette that creates a graceful and feminine look while keeping you comfortable throughout the day.

The convertible outer skirt layer allows you to style the dress in multiple ways — wear it open for a soft, layered look or adjust it for a more defined silhouette. The adjustable button detail allows you to customize the fit and style of the dress to your preference, creating either a relaxed, flowy look or a more structured shape.

Perfect for everyday elegance, gatherings, or special occasions, the Aurelia Dress combines modesty, comfort, and effortless style.

Details:

  • Convertible outer skirt for multiple styling options
  • Adjustable waist button detail for a customizable fit
  • Flowy layered maxi silhouette
  • Lightweight linen-blend fabric
  • Modest and elegant design

products.description_html:
A powerful expression of faith designed for the woman who finds peace in sujood and strength in stillness, the NISWA Masjid Is My Sanctuary Hoodie blends modest comfort with purposeful design. Featuring a bold puff-print NISWA logo on the front and the statement “The Masjid Is My Sanctuary” across the back, this piece is a reminder of where the heart truly belongs. Wear it to the masjid. Wear it while running errands. Wear it when you need comfort — inside and out.


Inspired by the Hadith:

“There are seven whom Allah will shade in His Shade on the Day when there is no shade except His Shade... one whose heart is attached to the masajid (mosques)...”
(Bukhari & Muslim)

Made for comfort and purpose, this hoodie is your reminder of where true peace resides. 

Product Specs:

·       Material: 100% cotton, 300 GSM

·       Fit: Relaxed, slightly oversized fit — true to streetwear sizing for a clean silhouette

·       Design: Bold white puff-print NISWA logo on the chest; clean, minimalist, and versatile; graffiti-style puff print on the back for a bold statement.
Features: Ribbed cuffs and hem & spacious kangaroo pocket

·       Wearability: Ideal for everyday movement — from errands and the masjid to workouts and everything in between.
